newsitem.title: USA: CFM Technologies files for 1.67 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: CFM Technologies files for 1.67 mln shrs.

text.p: CFM Technologies Inc said on Friday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up 1,670,000 common shares.
Of the total, 1.5 million will be sold by the company and 170,000 by selling shareholders, the filing said. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 7,553,340 common.

The company granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to buy up to 250,500 additional shares. The offering will be made through Montgomery Securities, PaineWebber Inc and UBS Securities.
Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including working capital, the company said.
CFM, based in West Chester, Pa., designs, manufactures and markets advanced wet processing equipment for sale to the worldwide semiconductor and flat panel display industries.
